## About
Bojan's Auto Body is a family owned collision repair business serving Chicago's north shore. John started the company as a mechanical shop, added collision repair shortly after, and moved to Dundee Rd in Northbrook, where the shop still is today.
His sons Mike, Tom and Dan took over when John retired, and Jonathan later joined as a collision repair technician. Most of our technicians have been with us long enough to remember working for John. We believe in hiring only the best and holding on to them.
Customer service and quality are our number one concern. Our customers have given us a 4.5 rating from 30 Google reviews.

## Services
- Collision repair: Repair after an accident, from fender benders to bigger body damage, finished with a clean paint job.
- Body damage repairs: We fix body damage on cars and other vehicles. One reviewer who switched to us for this work called our pricing reasonable and fair.

## FAQ
Q: What are your hours?
A: We're open Monday through Friday from 7:00 AM to 4:30 PM.

Q: Are you open on weekends?
A: No, we're closed on Saturday and Sunday.

Q: Where is the shop?
A: You'll find us at 525 Dundee Rd in Northbrook, IL 60062.
